findings.issue: Vocabulary and earlier layer/candidate note members are scanned for type/token length before every candidate/layer membership cap has been checked. This violates the approved global bounded-shape/count stage before member scans and changes the specified error-stage precedence.
findings.actual_evidence: Three independent cases combine an early malformed member type with a later513-membership layer. Current code raises TypeError Invalid typed input while the global count stage should first reject ValueError Input bound exceeded. Probe cases cover vocabulary-before-candidate, earlier-candidate-before-later-candidate and earlier-layer-before-later-layer.
findings.expected_correction: Separate bounded container/record-shape and complete membership-count pass from all vocabulary/profile/layer/query token/member scans. Preserve exact types needed to inspect containers safely, then enforce every512/32768 cap before scanning any member values; do not alter accepted policies/errors or weaken validation.
findings.future_regression_controls: Add explicit negative tests for all three precedence cases and a valid-at-bound control. Preserve original probe report and rerun focused/regression after the targeted source correction.
findings.scope: Approved contract conformance and bounded resource validation; no demonstrated data/rights bypass or scoring-formula defect
